_doc: Phase 7 radar decisions (BeamNGTrigger speedTrapType=speed, speedLimit in m/s). Rule: radar == regulated limit of the road it enforces (enforced direction measured in game: trigger y axis vs road flow). No trigger sets speedLimitTolerance: the game default (10 % of the limit) is kept.

changes.name: speedTrapTrigger2
changes.reason: O radar acompanha o limite regulamentado da via fiscalizada: DR652 (corredor 70 do Event 01). O gatilho fiscaliza o sentido do fluxo dessa via (produto escalar 1,0). Tolerância original preservada (speedLimit * 0,1).
